test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 29 Aug 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: FM 25 is related to IJ 125 in a certain way. In the same way, NO 36 is related to QL 216. To which of the following is MP16 related following the same logic?
solution:
The alphabets and their positions:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/26d6744000c534bf451c1971808a438dd123f54abcc92aa982430e4ce5f353c2.png] 

The logic followed in the given codes is:

**First term is increased by 3.**

**Second term is decreased by 3.**

**The number is multiplied by its root value.**

Now, FM 25 is related to IJ 125 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7ea53ec1c9f8357bf73b033c033fda816b8f91b8a55dac12ba4433cfc60dd508.png] 

For, NO 36 is related to QL 216

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e9c98730165a67ee7002061cf8bf496d6ac8361f4a0058854cae7716329008da.png] 

Similarly, for MP16:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/68b2d1e0cf52a153b425abce5171c5f7d70705219acdaea78039bf8ee913f92d.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **Option 2.**
